entries.b9e1b67a8cfce36c: This is a single-segment business that manufactures and sells paint. The company manufactures and tints paint at its head office plant (Amagasaki, Hyogo Prefecture), the Tokyo plant, the Chiba plant and others, and sells it partly directly to customers and mainly through exclusive dealers. The consolidated subsidiary Daiyasu Kasei Co., Ltd. and the equity-method affiliate Yūshin Shokai Co., Ltd. also handle sales of the company's products. Revenue for the fiscal year ended November 2025 was ¥5,932 million, which accounts for all of consolidated revenue.
